items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Um, Richard – the pianist at Arturo’s?

ctx.x: Would you say you had an incredibly large proportion of musicians that came out of Detroit, related to other areas of the country? Would you say that?

Yeah, well what it is, is all the musicians that left with me, they all made it in New York. Every musician, I don’t know any one that didn’t, you know. Um, what’s the pianist’s name at Arturo? Um, Richard – the pianist at Arturo’s? No, the regular pianist that played for the singers and stuff
